errors.quote: There are $b+1$ rounds on prefix slots and $qK$ on chunks, $\ell$ in all.
errors.problem: The leading round at $h=\ell-1$ happens only when some axis is long. If every axis is short, there are $b$ prefix rounds and $\ell-1$ rounds in total. The paper says \"at most $b+1\leq K$ rounds on prefix slots\" and \"at most $\ell$ rounds\". The page's later \"the $\ell$ rounds leave error below\" inherits this. The bounds are unaffected.

errors.quote: each round of a synthetic polynomial transform runs as one simultaneous butterfly layer instead of one pass per axis
errors.problem: Only the $qK$ chunk rounds run as one simultaneous layer. The up to $b+1$ rounds on prefix slots process each participating bit individually, as the page itself says later and as the paper's proof does.
